spreads.text: Little Goat went to find the sweetest grass. The sky was blue above. But she did not look up.
The river gurgled below. But Little Goat did not listen to its song.
A bird called to her, saying, “How do you do?” But Little Goat didn’t answer.
She just walked along looking for the sweetest grass.
As she walked along, Little Goat moved further and further away from Mother Goat.
Little Goat found the sweetest grass. She ate and ate. She had walked far from Mother Goat.
Mother Goat wondered where Little Goat had gone. She looked in the mealie patch, but Little Goat was not there.
Mother Goat ran to the river. But Little Goat was not there. “Where are you, Little Goat,” bleated Mother Goat.
A bird called to Mother Goat. “Little Goat is asleep in the sweet grass across the bridge.”
Mother Goat crossed the bridge, to the sweet grass.
There she found Little Goat fast asleep.
“Wake up, Little Goat,” said Mother Goat gently. “You were lost!” “I wasn’t lost... I have been here all the time!” said Little Goat.

pages.en: Little Goat went to find the sweetest grass. The sky was blue above. But she did not look up.
pages.sourceText: Little Goat went to find the sweetest grass. The sky was blue above. But she did not look up.
pages.zh: 小山羊去寻找最甜的青草。头顶的天空蓝蓝的，可她没有抬头看。
pages.tip: 指指青草，再看看头顶：小山羊有没有抬头？
pages.alt: 小山羊去寻找最甜的青草。头顶的天空蓝蓝的，可她没有抬头看。

pages.en: The river gurgled below. But Little Goat did not listen to its song.
pages.sourceText: The river gurgled below. But Little Goat did not listen to its song.
pages.zh: 河水在下面潺潺流淌，可小山羊没有听它的歌。
pages.tip: 用手指沿着河水轻轻划一划。
pages.alt: 河水在下面潺潺流淌，可小山羊没有听它的歌。

pages.en: A bird called to her, saying, “How do you do?”
pages.sourceText: A bird called to her, saying, “How do you do?”
pages.zh: 一只小鸟向她喊道：“你好呀！”
pages.tip: 像小鸟一样向小山羊轻轻打个招呼。
pages.alt: 一只小鸟向她喊道：“你好呀！”

pages.en: But Little Goat didn’t answer.
pages.sourceText: But Little Goat didn’t answer.
pages.zh: 可是小山羊没有回答。
pages.tip: 看看小山羊，猜猜她是不是还在找青草。
pages.alt: 可是小山羊没有回答。

pages.en: She just walked along looking for the sweetest grass.
pages.sourceText: She just walked along looking for the sweetest grass.
pages.zh: 她只是一直往前走，寻找最甜的青草。
pages.tip: 用两根手指演一演小山羊走路。
pages.alt: 她只是一直往前走，寻找最甜的青草。

pages.en: As she walked along, Little Goat moved further and further away from Mother Goat.
pages.sourceText: As she walked along, Little Goat moved further and further away from Mother Goat.
pages.zh: 小山羊走着走着，离山羊妈妈越来越远。
pages.tip: 分别指指妈妈和小山羊，看看她们离得多远。
pages.alt: 小山羊走着走着，离山羊妈妈越来越远。

pages.en: Little Goat found the sweetest grass. She ate and ate.
pages.sourceText: Little Goat found the sweetest grass. She ate and ate.
pages.zh: 小山羊找到了最甜的青草。她吃呀吃。
pages.tip: 像小山羊一样轻轻做个嚼青草的动作。
pages.alt: 小山羊找到了最甜的青草。她吃呀吃。

pages.en: She had walked far from Mother Goat.
pages.sourceText: She had walked far from Mother Goat.
pages.zh: 她已经走得离山羊妈妈很远了。
pages.tip: 指指小山羊，想想妈妈在哪里。
pages.alt: 她已经走得离山羊妈妈很远了。

pages.en: Mother Goat wondered where Little Goat had gone. She looked in the mealie patch, but Little Goat was not there.
pages.sourceText: Mother Goat wondered where Little Goat had gone. She looked in the mealie patch, but Little Goat was not there.
pages.zh: 山羊妈妈想知道小山羊去了哪里。她在玉米地里找，可小山羊不在那里。
pages.tip: 陪妈妈在玉米地里找一找。
pages.alt: 山羊妈妈想知道小山羊去了哪里。她在玉米地里找，可小山羊不在那里。

pages.en: Mother Goat ran to the river. But Little Goat was not there. “Where are you, Little Goat,” bleated Mother Goat.
pages.sourceText: Mother Goat ran to the river. But Little Goat was not there. “Where are you, Little Goat,” bleated Mother Goat.
pages.zh: 山羊妈妈跑到河边，可小山羊不在那里。“小山羊，你在哪里？”妈妈咩咩地叫着。
pages.tip: 像妈妈一样轻轻叫一声小山羊。
pages.alt: 山羊妈妈跑到河边，可小山羊不在那里。“小山羊，你在哪里？”妈妈咩咩地叫着。

pages.en: A bird called to Mother Goat. “Little Goat is asleep in the sweet grass across the bridge.”
pages.sourceText: A bird called to Mother Goat. “Little Goat is asleep in the sweet grass across the bridge.”
pages.zh: 一只小鸟对山羊妈妈喊：“小山羊在桥那边的青草丛里睡着了。”
pages.tip: 指指小鸟，它告诉了妈妈什么？可以用中文说。
pages.alt: 一只小鸟对山羊妈妈喊：“小山羊在桥那边的青草丛里睡着了。”

pages.en: Mother Goat crossed the bridge, to the sweet grass.
pages.sourceText: Mother Goat crossed the bridge, to the sweet grass.
pages.zh: 山羊妈妈过了桥，来到甜甜的青草丛。
pages.tip: 用手指沿着小桥走到另一边。
pages.alt: 山羊妈妈过了桥，来到甜甜的青草丛。

pages.en: There she found Little Goat fast asleep.
pages.sourceText: There she found Little Goat fast asleep.
pages.zh: 她在那里找到了睡得正香的小山羊。
pages.tip: 轻声说 asleep，再做一个安静的睡觉动作。
pages.alt: 她在那里找到了睡得正香的小山羊。

pages.en: “Wake up, Little Goat,” said Mother Goat gently. “You were lost!”
pages.sourceText: “Wake up, Little Goat,” said Mother Goat gently. “You were lost!”
pages.zh: “醒醒，小山羊。”妈妈温柔地说，“你走丢啦！”
pages.tip: 用温柔的声音学妈妈叫醒小山羊。
pages.alt: “醒醒，小山羊。”妈妈温柔地说，“你走丢啦！”

pages.en: “I wasn’t lost... I have been here all the time!” said Little Goat.
pages.sourceText: “I wasn’t lost... I have been here all the time!” said Little Goat.
pages.zh: “我没有走丢呀……我一直都在这里！”小山羊说。
pages.tip: 看看小山羊的表情，轻轻抱一抱身边的孩子。
pages.alt: “我没有走丢呀……我一直都在这里！”小山羊说。

activity.title: 一起找妈妈
activity.text: 用玩偶演一演小山羊和妈妈的故事，出门时记得和大人待在一起。
activity.hint: 指一指、聊一聊就好，不需要打卡。

spreads.text: This is Pabi. This is her dog Boo. Boo has a very clever nose. They are going to find a rainbow with Boo’s nose. Let’s go!
Boo smells something green. Sniff, sniff, sniff. Boo finds smelly green socks. Can we eat smelly green socks? No! Boo’s nose smells some green ...
Spinach! Can we eat spinach? Yes! And green beans! Crunchy beans and salty spinach. Can you think of something green that is good to eat?
Boo smells something red. Sniff, sniff, sniff. Oh! Boo smells red soap. Can we eat this red soapy soap? No! Boo’s nose smells some red ...
Tomatoes! Can we eat tomatoes? Yes! And beetroot! Tasty tomatoes and beautiful beetroot! Can you think of something red that is good to eat?
Boo smells something orange. Sniff, sniff, sniff. Boo smells an orange bottle. Can we eat a bottle? No! Boo’s nose smells an orange ...
Pumpkin! Can we eat pumpkin? Yes! And oranges! Sweet, juicy oranges and spicy pumpkin. Can you think of something orange that is good to eat?
Boo smells something yellow. Sniff, sniff, sniff. Boo smells her yellow ball. Can we eat Boo’s yellow ball? No! Boo’s nose smells some yellow ...
Mielies! Can we eat mielies? Yes! And bananas! Crunchy, crispy mielies and beautiful, big bananas. Can you think of something yellow that is good to eat?
Boo and Pabi found green beans. And red tomatoes. And orange pumpkin. And yellow mielies. How beautiful! ‘Can we make a rainbow, Boo?’ asks Pabi.
Yes! Look! ‘We are cooking a big, juicy, sweet, crispy, beautiful rainbow,’ says Pabi. ‘Can we eat our rainbow, Boo?’
‘Yes, we can! Our rainbow tastes good! It makes us big and strong!’ You can eat a rainbow too!

pages.en: This is Pabi. This is her dog Boo.
pages.sourceText: This is Pabi. This is her dog Boo.
pages.zh: 这是帕比。这是她的小狗布布。
pages.tip: 分别指指帕比和布布。
pages.alt: 这是帕比。这是她的小狗布布。

pages.en: Boo has a very clever nose. They are going to find a rainbow with Boo’s nose. Let’s go!
pages.sourceText: Boo has a very clever nose. They are going to find a rainbow with Boo’s nose. Let’s go!
pages.zh: 布布有一个很灵的鼻子。他们要靠布布的鼻子去寻找彩虹。出发吧！
pages.tip: 指指彩虹，说一种你看见的颜色。
pages.alt: 布布有一个很灵的鼻子。他们要靠布布的鼻子去寻找彩虹。出发吧！

pages.en: Boo smells something green. Sniff, sniff, sniff. Boo finds smelly green socks.
pages.sourceText: Boo smells something green. Sniff, sniff, sniff. Boo finds smelly green socks.
pages.zh: 布布闻到了绿色的东西。闻呀闻。布布找到了臭臭的绿袜子。
pages.tip: 学布布轻轻闻一闻，再指指袜子。
pages.alt: 布布闻到了绿色的东西。闻呀闻。布布找到了臭臭的绿袜子。

pages.en: Can we eat smelly green socks? No! Boo’s nose smells some green ...
pages.sourceText: Can we eat smelly green socks? No! Boo’s nose smells some green ...
pages.zh: 臭臭的绿袜子能吃吗？不能！布布的鼻子又闻到了一些绿色的……
pages.tip: 一起摇摇头，袜子不能吃。
pages.alt: 臭臭的绿袜子能吃吗？不能！布布的鼻子又闻到了一些绿色的……

pages.en: Spinach! Can we eat spinach? Yes! And green beans!
pages.sourceText: Spinach! Can we eat spinach? Yes! And green beans!
pages.zh: 菠菜！我们能吃菠菜吗？能！还有四季豆！
pages.tip: 找找小菠菜和豆苗，看看它们是什么颜色。
pages.alt: 菠菜！我们能吃菠菜吗？能！还有四季豆！

pages.en: Crunchy beans and salty spinach. Can you think of something green that is good to eat?
pages.sourceText: Crunchy beans and salty spinach. Can you think of something green that is good to eat?
pages.zh: 脆脆的豆子和咸香的菠菜。你能想到什么绿色、又能吃的东西吗？
pages.tip: 指一种蔬菜就好，也可以用中文说出你想到的食物。
pages.alt: 脆脆的豆子和咸香的菠菜。你能想到什么绿色、又能吃的东西吗？

pages.en: Boo smells something red. Sniff, sniff, sniff. Oh! Boo smells red soap.
pages.sourceText: Boo smells something red. Sniff, sniff, sniff. Oh! Boo smells red soap.
pages.zh: 布布闻到了红色的东西。闻呀闻。哦！布布闻到了红色的肥皂。
pages.tip: 指指冒泡泡的红肥皂。
pages.alt: 布布闻到了红色的东西。闻呀闻。哦！布布闻到了红色的肥皂。

pages.en: Can we eat this red soapy soap? No! Boo’s nose smells some red ...
pages.sourceText: Can we eat this red soapy soap? No! Boo’s nose smells some red ...
pages.zh: 这块红红的、起泡泡的肥皂能吃吗？不能！布布的鼻子又闻到了一些红色的……
pages.tip: 轻轻摇头，说说肥皂是用来做什么的。
pages.alt: 这块红红的、起泡泡的肥皂能吃吗？不能！布布的鼻子又闻到了一些红色的……

pages.en: Tomatoes! Can we eat tomatoes? Yes! And beetroot!
pages.sourceText: Tomatoes! Can we eat tomatoes? Yes! And beetroot!
pages.zh: 番茄！我们能吃番茄吗？能！还有甜菜根！
pages.tip: 指指藤上的番茄，再看看右边的大番茄。
pages.alt: 番茄！我们能吃番茄吗？能！还有甜菜根！

pages.en: Tasty tomatoes and beautiful beetroot! Can you think of something red that is good to eat?
pages.sourceText: Tasty tomatoes and beautiful beetroot! Can you think of something red that is good to eat?
pages.zh: 美味的番茄和漂亮的甜菜根！你能想到什么红色、又能吃的东西吗？
pages.tip: 一起想一种红色食物，不要求孩子回答完整英文。
pages.alt: 美味的番茄和漂亮的甜菜根！你能想到什么红色、又能吃的东西吗？

pages.en: Boo smells something orange. Sniff, sniff, sniff. Boo smells an orange bottle.
pages.sourceText: Boo smells something orange. Sniff, sniff, sniff. Boo smells an orange bottle.
pages.zh: 布布闻到了橙色的东西。闻呀闻。布布闻到了一个橙色的奶瓶。
pages.tip: 找找宝宝身边的橙色奶瓶。
pages.alt: 布布闻到了橙色的东西。闻呀闻。布布闻到了一个橙色的奶瓶。

pages.en: Can we eat a bottle? No! Boo’s nose smells an orange ...
pages.sourceText: Can we eat a bottle? No! Boo’s nose smells an orange ...
pages.zh: 奶瓶能吃吗？不能！布布的鼻子又闻到了一个橙色的……
pages.tip: 摇摇头，再猜猜下一页会出现什么。
pages.alt: 奶瓶能吃吗？不能！布布的鼻子又闻到了一个橙色的……

pages.en: Pumpkin! Can we eat pumpkin? Yes! And oranges!
pages.sourceText: Pumpkin! Can we eat pumpkin? Yes! And oranges!
pages.zh: 南瓜！我们能吃南瓜吗？能！还有橙子！
pages.tip: 找找头顶的南瓜，和孩子轻松指一指。
pages.alt: 南瓜！我们能吃南瓜吗？能！还有橙子！

pages.en: Sweet, juicy oranges and spicy pumpkin. Can you think of something orange that is good to eat?
pages.sourceText: Sweet, juicy oranges and spicy pumpkin. Can you think of something orange that is good to eat?
pages.zh: 甜甜多汁的橙子和香辣的南瓜。你能想到什么橙色、又能吃的东西吗？
pages.tip: 比较南瓜和橙子的形状，圆圆的各指一个。
pages.alt: 甜甜多汁的橙子和香辣的南瓜。你能想到什么橙色、又能吃的东西吗？

pages.en: Boo smells something yellow. Sniff, sniff, sniff. Boo smells her yellow ball.
pages.sourceText: Boo smells something yellow. Sniff, sniff, sniff. Boo smells her yellow ball.
pages.zh: 布布闻到了黄色的东西。闻呀闻。布布闻到了她的黄色小球。
pages.tip: 指指球，学小狗伸个懒腰。
pages.alt: 布布闻到了黄色的东西。闻呀闻。布布闻到了她的黄色小球。

pages.en: Can we eat Boo’s yellow ball? No! Boo’s nose smells some yellow ...
pages.sourceText: Can we eat Boo’s yellow ball? No! Boo’s nose smells some yellow ...
pages.zh: 布布的黄色小球能吃吗？不能！布布的鼻子又闻到了一些黄色的……
pages.tip: 一起摇头，再找找黄色。
pages.alt: 布布的黄色小球能吃吗？不能！布布的鼻子又闻到了一些黄色的……

pages.en: Mielies! Can we eat mielies? Yes! And bananas!
pages.sourceText: Mielies! Can we eat mielies? Yes! And bananas!
pages.zh: 玉米！我们能吃玉米吗？能！还有香蕉！
pages.tip: 找找布布头顶上的香蕉。
pages.alt: 玉米！我们能吃玉米吗？能！还有香蕉！

pages.en: Crunchy, crispy mielies and beautiful, big bananas. Can you think of something yellow that is good to eat?
pages.sourceText: Crunchy, crispy mielies and beautiful, big bananas. Can you think of something yellow that is good to eat?
pages.zh: 脆脆的玉米和漂亮的大香蕉。你能想到什么黄色、又能吃的东西吗？
pages.tip: 指指玉米和香蕉，选一种你喜欢的。
pages.alt: 脆脆的玉米和漂亮的大香蕉。你能想到什么黄色、又能吃的东西吗？

pages.en: Boo and Pabi found green beans. And red tomatoes. And orange pumpkin. And yellow mielies.
pages.sourceText: Boo and Pabi found green beans. And red tomatoes. And orange pumpkin. And yellow mielies.
pages.zh: 布布和帕比找到了绿豆角、红番茄、橙色南瓜和黄色玉米。
pages.tip: 每种颜色各指一种食物。
pages.alt: 布布和帕比找到了绿豆角、红番茄、橙色南瓜和黄色玉米。

pages.en: How beautiful! ‘Can we make a rainbow, Boo?’ asks Pabi.
pages.sourceText: How beautiful! ‘Can we make a rainbow, Boo?’ asks Pabi.
pages.zh: 真漂亮！“布布，我们能做一道彩虹吗？”帕比问。
pages.tip: 看看找到的食物，猜猜可以怎么摆出彩虹。
pages.alt: 真漂亮！“布布，我们能做一道彩虹吗？”帕比问。

pages.en: Yes! Look! ‘We are cooking a big, juicy, sweet, crispy, beautiful rainbow,’ says Pabi. ‘Can we eat our rainbow, Boo?’
pages.sourceText: Yes! Look! ‘We are cooking a big, juicy, sweet, crispy, beautiful rainbow,’ says Pabi. ‘Can we eat our rainbow, Boo?’
pages.zh: 能！看！“我们正在做一道又大、又多汁、又甜、又脆、又漂亮的彩虹！”帕比说，“布布，我们能吃这道彩虹吗？”
pages.tip: 指指妈妈和帕比，做饭时请大人帮忙。
pages.alt: 能！看！“我们正在做一道又大、又多汁、又甜、又脆、又漂亮的彩虹！”帕比说，“布布，我们能吃这道彩虹吗？”

pages.en: ‘Yes, we can! Our rainbow tastes good! It makes us big and strong!’ You can eat a rainbow too!
pages.sourceText: ‘Yes, we can! Our rainbow tastes good! It makes us big and strong!’ You can eat a rainbow too!
pages.zh: “能，我们能吃！我们的彩虹真好吃！它让我们长得又高又壮！”你也可以吃一道彩虹！
pages.tip: 看看餐盘里的颜色，想想今天的一餐有什么颜色。
pages.alt: “能，我们能吃！我们的彩虹真好吃！它让我们长得又高又壮！”你也可以吃一道彩虹！

activity.title: 餐盘里的彩虹
activity.text: 和孩子找一找今天餐桌上的颜色，各指一种食物。准备食物时由大人负责清洗和切配。
activity.hint: 指一指、聊一聊就好，不需要打卡。
